description:
TSC in Trumbull CT, is seeking a Radar Systems / Software Engineer  to support airborne surveillance radar programs for customers, including the US Army and its prime contractors. TSC has several ongoing development and sustainment programs that are leveraging Modeling and Simulation (M&S) to reduce the expense of flight-testing programs.  This position will focus on integrating the various pieces of the M&S framework together, including modes, a target tracker, a platform model, an antenna model, and more.  Prior experience in Ground Moving Target Indication (GMTI), Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and maritime surface surveillance is highly desirable, as interpretation of the results from the M&S framework is a key part of our role. Some business travel may be required.
 
 Responsibilities:  
 Work with senior engineers to integrate and test various pieces of M&S framework
 Develop near-real-time code such that models can deliver answers in a rapid fashion
 Critically interpret results and recommend software/algorithm fixes to the senior engineering team
 Recommend laboratory and flight testing to assess performance
 Review and analyze collected test results
 Brief technical accomplishments to mixed audiences of technical and managerial staff
 Required Qualifications: 
 B.S. (M.S. preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Computer Engineering
 5+ years of related radar work experience
 5+ years in modeling and simulation development and execution
 Knowledge of various software development environments, including Windows and Linux-based systems
 Proficiency in several programming languages and methods, such as MATLAB, Python, C, C++, CUDA, and VHDL
 High-level understanding of model-based engineering, radar system design, real-time radar signal processing, and potential radar hardware and software issues
 Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security (Top Secret preferred) clearance.
 U.S. Citizenship required
 
 In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, the expected salary range for this position is $105,000 – $170,000 per year, depending on experience and location. This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus and may include equity or incentive compensation as part of the total rewards package.
 
 TSC Benefits: 
 TSC offers a stable work environment, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefit package; including ESOP participation, 401k Plan, Flexible Work Schedules, Tuition Reimbursement, Co-Sponsored Health Plan, Paid Leave and much more. 
 
 Applying to TSC: 
 Only those candidates invited for an interview will be contacted. Employment at TSC is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check, security investigation, and a drug screening.
